curl -s 'https://daten.marnau-institut.example/v2/stations/14/readings' \
  --get \
  --data-urlencode 'from=2025-07-01T00:00:00Z' \
  --data-urlencode 'to=2025-07-31T23:59:59Z' \
  --data-urlencode 'fields=level,temperature' \
  --data-urlencode 'series=raw'

# 15-minute values, ISO 8601 timestamps, UTC.
# Omit series=raw to get the quality-checked series instead.
caption: shell
note: The endpoint is open and unauthenticated up to 5,000 requests a day. Above that, register for a key on the data portal.
